about: Sign-up flows (contract v1, "Sign-up flows"): register (POST /v1/register → /v1/register/verify), recover (POST /v1/agents/recover → /recover/verify) and rotate key (POST /v1/agents/{handle}/rotate-key → /verify, with the current key as Bearer). Every answer carries a flow object: at the top level of a 2xx body, in `details` of an error body (flow = body.code ? body.details : body); it is a flow only when it has a string next_step, else the answer is from an older server (action legacy). Each case gives the request (kind = the step that was called), the server response (status, the Retry-After header when sent, body) and what a client derives: expect.flow lists every flow field present with its value (a parser may keep more keys, never fewer or different ones), expect.code and expect.message (the text to show verbatim; never branch on it), and expect.action = actionOf(flow, HTTP status, called step), first match wins: no flow → legacy; next_step done → done (the key is in the body); HTTP 5xx → stop (after a verify 500 the account may exist); next_step a verify step and no retry_after_s → ask_code; next_step a start step with param → ask_param (ask that input again, then call the start step); next_step a start step, no param, status expired or max_attempts_reached or the answer a 429 to a called verify step, and retry_after_s absent or ≤ wait_limit_s → offer_new_code (ask the person before sending a new code; wait retry_after_s, and resend_after_s, first if they accept); HTTP 429, retry_after_s ≤ wait_limit_s and next_step equal to the called step → wait_then_retry (wait, then repeat it); anything else → stop (show message, end). OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED carries no Retry-After and no retry_after_s, only resend_after_s. Times are fixed; api_key values are placeholders.
